subject: update avx512 prefetch distance for gcc and clang
perf_evidence: The commit changes AVX512 prefetch distances separately for clang (64/128: 320/320) and GCC (640/512), from 496/384.
change_summary: Only the address passed to XXH_PREFETCH in the AVX512 XXH3_accumulate stripe loop changes; the hash arithmetic and loads are unchanged.

units.name: XXH3_accumulate, one stripe, AVX512, 64/128-bit widths, clang branch
units.evidence: target_acc64/target_acc128: Alive2 forward and backward correct; IR differs only in the prefetch address.

units.name: XXH3_accumulate, one stripe, AVX512, 64/128-bit widths, GCC preprocessor branch
units.evidence: target_acc64/target_acc128: Alive2 forward and backward correct with -U__clang__ selecting the GCC branch.

units.name: XXH3_64bits/XXH3_128bits, 256 bytes, AVX512, clang branch
units.evidence: Public target_api64/target_api128 bidirectional correct in result.json; their noinline XXH3_hashLong_{64b,128b}_defaultSecret callees separately bidirectional correct in helpers_fwd.log/helpers_bwd.log (2/2 each direction).

units.name: XXH3_64bits/XXH3_128bits, 256 bytes, AVX512, GCC preprocessor branch
units.evidence: Public targets bidirectional correct in result.json; noinline callees separately bidirectional correct in helpers_fwd.log/helpers_bwd.log.

notes: Proof scope is fixed 256-byte inputs and AVX512. The GCC branch is selected by -U__clang__ while still compiling with clang; actual GCC code generation is not checked. Public targets call noinline helpers, so the separate helper proofs are needed; public-target checks alone would be insufficient. Arbitrary lengths and other compiler/ISA configurations remain outside this proof.
